resources.string: A private fitness companion designed to work offline.
Browse simple bodyweight movements offline. Choose a pace and range of motion that feels comfortable.
Stand in front of a stable chair with feet about hip-width apart.
Send hips back toward the seat, then stand while keeping the chair within reach.
Face a clear wall and place hands at chest height, slightly wider than shoulders.
Bend elbows toward the wall, then press back while keeping the body in a comfortable line.
Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, about hip-width apart.
Gently lift hips, pause briefly, then lower with control.
Stand tall near a stable support if you want one.
Alternate lifting each foot at a comfortable height and pace.
Lie on your back with knees bent above hips and arms reaching upward.
Slowly lower one heel and the opposite arm, return, and change sides.
Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Gently round the back, then return to a neutral position without forcing the range.
Sit near the front of a stable chair and extend one leg with the heel down.
Hinge forward slightly from the hips until you feel a mild stretch, then switch sides.
Use a stable support if balance feels uncertain.
Keep the movement comfortable for your shoulders.
Stop if you feel pain or discomfort in your back.
Use a comfortable hand position and stop if wrists hurt.
Stop the stretch if it causes pain.

Recording, history, analytics, plans, and saved routes are stored in the app’s private local database and remain available offline. Location is requested only for recording. Signing in turns on private backup for the signed-in account. Activities recorded while signed out stay on this phone unless you choose to link them. Optional AI uses only aggregate counts, distance, moving time, sport categories, and your selected focus; GPS and activity notes are excluded. Account deletion removes the account’s cloud records, AI usage records, and archives, plus this account’s local rows. Local-only data is not included unless you choose to link it.
Send a small training summary to AI?

When you ask for an insight or workout, Pace sends only aggregate counts, distance, moving time, sport categories, and a selected focus to OpenRouter. If OpenRouter is unavailable or returns invalid output, the same summary may be sent to Google Gemini. OpenRouter routing excludes providers that collect data, but free-tier Gemini prompts may be used to improve Google products. GPS coordinates, route archives, activity titles, notes, and account email are excluded. AI is unavailable offline and is not used for recording or local analytics. You can turn it off here at any time.

GPS: allow precise location while recording, enable device location, and keep the Pace recording notification visible. Offline maps: a map style may need internet until a licensed offline region is available. Backup: enable cloud backup in Profile, check the signed-in account and connection, and use Sync now. Restore: keep the app open for foreground restore; cancel is safe and retry resumes from saved timestamps. AI: AI is optional, needs a signed-in account and network access, and never replaces local planning.
